designObjective: Prove DangoUI as a restrained, high-density documentation system: a responsive navigation-reading-outline shell, editorial technical hierarchy, compact state-accurate controls, and a source-independent held-out guide that reuses those rules without turning purple into generic decoration.
visualPriorityOrder: content visibility, legibility and complete reading access
documentation shell composition and orientation hierarchy
technical content sequence and information density
narrow current-navigation and primary-action purple roles
compact control geometry and truthful interaction states

sections.firstImpressionGoal: A quiet four-zone desktop documentation frame makes the long-form Introduction immediately readable, with the technical process surface carrying the main visual mass; mobile becomes one continuous reading column rather than a miniature desktop grid.
mustPreserve: desktop left navigation and right outline around the reading column
mayChange: mobile line wrapping needed for full readability
mustNotDo: use the source screenshot as runtime content
replace the technical sequence with an equal card grid
add unsupported shadow depth or decorative imagery
uniformly scale the desktop shell on mobile
copy source horizontal clipping as a brand requirement

sections.firstImpressionGoal: A dense component-reference page pairs independently reviewable live button modules with code, keeping compact controls and their exact state semantics visible without turning the page into a generic component gallery.
mustPreserve: page title and concise component description
live-example and code relationship on desktop
stable purple fill through hover and activation
mayChange: mobile stacking while every module remains reachable
mustNotDo: collapse all examples into one showcase strip
invent hover transforms, shadows or pressed fills
merge navigation purple and Primary-button purple
allow wide control rows to become permanently unreachable

sections.firstImpressionGoal: A new release-readiness guide feels native to the same DangoUI documentation system through shell roles, technical hierarchy, compact truthful actions and restrained purple state cues, while using content and structure that do not exist on the source pages.
mustPreserve: current-navigation and Primary-action purple roles remain separate
normal phone mockup remains visible and scrollable
mustNotDo: claim unsupported global typography, motion or elevation
use purple as a page or section background
treat changed copy alone as generative proof

responsiveStrategyMatrix.minimumReadableSize: 12px labels / 44px interactive targets where controls are enabled
14px navigation text / no hidden fake controls
16px body / 36px page title desktop with readable mobile wrapping

mustPreserve: mobile removal without lost reading access

responsiveStrategyMatrix.minimumReadableSize: 12px-equivalent monospaced technical content without permanent horizontal loss
12px code / 14px example labels with vertical mobile stacking
32px documented visual height with an accessible hit target or explicit documentation-only boundary
14px current-location label when navigation is rendered

proofSurfacePlan.desktopCanvas: Independent 1440x900 source/demo captures for Introduction and Button plus a held-out documentation guide; calibration content viewport excludes inspector chrome.
proofSurfacePlan.mobileCanvas: Independent 390x844 captures prove single-column reflow and complete reading access while the normal user route retains the visible phone mockup and a separate explicit proof mode exposes the calibration canvas.
proofSurfacePlan.inspectorPolicy: Exclude app rail, browser chrome, debug overlays, selection outlines and annotations from fidelity captures; validate the normal mockup route separately from proof canvases.
proofSurfacePlan.sourceComparison: Compare source and demo at the same viewport with bounded regions for shell, hierarchy, reference modules and controls; operate scroll and Primary states, then confirm restoration. Judge held-out only on frozen-rule reuse and structural novelty.

orchestratorDecision.readabilityCorrection: Preserve the observed mobile reading-first reflow, but do not reproduce source horizontal clipping where it would hide content; this is an accessibility/readability correction, not a new brand pattern.
orchestratorDecision.colorBoundary: #5854FF remains current-navigation only and #7C66FF remains the observed normal Primary fill; neither becomes generic section chrome.
orchestratorDecision.assetBoundary: Use DOM/CSS reconstruction and independent Demo content; source screenshots remain QA evidence only.
orchestratorDecision.publication: Keep dango-v2 outside preview and public Registry until implementation self-test, fresh independent Blind QA, all three proof gates, handoff/retro gates, build, registry build and release validation pass.
